title: "Review fixes: landscape validation"
output:
  html_document:
    self_contained: true
---

This preview checks the repaired tied-value surface and weighting/concatenation.
The cup depths and bootstrap units now follow the supplied network settings.

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
pkgload::load_all('.',quiet=TRUE)
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo=TRUE,fig.width=9,fig.height=6)
```

## Weighted transition landscape

```{r weighted}
d <- data.frame(T1=c('A','A','B'),T2=c('A','B','A'),
                T3=c('A',NA,'B'),T4=c('B',NA,'A'))
n <- build_network(d,method='relative',params=list(weighted=TRUE))
print(n$weights)
land <- stability_landscape(n,iter=50,seed=1)
summary(land)
plot(land)
```

## Concatenated sequence landscape

```{r concat}
n <- build_network(d[c('T1','T2')],method='relative',params=list(concat=3))
print(n$weights)
land <- stability_landscape(n,iter=20,seed=1)
summary(land)
plot(land)
```

## Nonconstant entropy with equal trimmed percentiles

This input previously returned a surface that failed to plot. The axis now
uses the full range when the trimmed endpoints coincide. Thin slices retain
the existing warning rather than concealing their limited support.

```{r tied}
s <- as.data.frame(matrix(rep(c('A','B','A','B'),each=21),nrow=21))
s[21,] <- c('A','A','B','A')
a <- landscape_surface(s,k=5)
summary(a)
plot(a)
```

## Tied numeric covariate

```{r covariate}
s$grade <- c(rep(10,20),20)
t <- landscape_trend(s,along='grade',iter=20,seed=1)
plot(t,type='surface')
```

## Boundary states are included in surface metrics

Prepared start markers now count as sequence positions both when calculating
stability measures and when estimating transitions.

```{r boundary}
d <- data.frame(T1=c('A','B','A','B','A','B'),
                T2=c('B','A','A','B','B','A'),
                T3=c('A','B','B','A','A','B'))
n <- build_network(d,method='relative',params=list(begin_state='A'))
surf <- landscape_surface(n,measure='self_loop_tendency',k=5,n_grid=3)
summary(surf)
plot(surf)
```
